name: synapse-retrieval-baseline-v1
purpose: Small, transparent synthetic corpus for repeatable offline retrieval ablations. It is not a representative production workload.

documents.content: The deployment pipeline runs only when a version tag is pushed; commits to ordinary branches do not publish a release.
Scheduled nightly integration tests run at 02:15 UTC from the main branch.
The stale cache TTL is 3600 seconds before entries are refreshed.
HTTP 429 means rate limit exceeded; clients should back off and follow the Retry-After header.
Encrypted PostgreSQL backups must be restored with the same SYNAPSE_ENCRYPTION_KEY used when data was written.
PostgreSQL row-level security and the tenant_id predicate prevent one tenant from reading another tenant's memories.
Local development supports SQLite with deterministic hash embeddings; those vectors are not semantic embeddings.
Changing embedding models or vector dimensions requires re-embedding existing memories before querying the new vector space.
The 3072-dimensional pgvector HNSW path uses a halfvec-compatible expression index.
The context packer chooses memory items that fit within the requested token budget.
Deleting a memory should remove it from the active result set; related projections and indexes must also be cleaned up.
Encryption key rotation keeps old keys available until data has been re-encrypted and verified.
Earlier user note from 2026-08-14: prefers Python for backend work. This is an old preference entry.
Current preference updated on 2026-10-22: the user prefers TypeScript for new backend services; this supersedes the earlier Python preference.
Legacy support policy allowed eligible refunds within 14 days of purchase; this policy has expired.
Current refund policy allows eligible requests within 30 calendar days of purchase when a receipt is available, replacing the old 14-day window.
Escalate a payments outage to the on-call engineer after confirming the service health alert.
Priority-one support tickets have an initial response target of 15 minutes during staffed hours.
The quarterly sales review is scheduled for Friday at 14:00 UTC.
Sales account notes should be retained for 24 months after account closure.
The sales team groups EMEA opportunities by country and expected close quarter.
Redis-backed rate limiting shares request counters across multiple engine replicas.
The root API key and encryption key are distinct secrets and must never be committed to source control.
